About this property

  • Short Lets
This stunning terraced family house set over five floors in the charming highly desirable street of Elgin Crescent. Compromising 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms (1 en suite), 2 reception rooms, kitchen/dining room, utility room, WC, private garden, direct access to the communal gardens, and driveway.

This beautifully designed family home is perfect for a family with use of the sought-after communal gardens on this colourfully painted crescent. The raised ground floor provides an excellent entertaining space with high ceilings, wooden flooring and two fireplaces. The lower ground floor benefits from a modern, open-plan kitchen dining, with utility room as well as a reception area leading out onto the rear garden. The principal bedroom situated on the first floor features a dressing room which flows onto the en suite with separate shower and bath. The second and third floors each feature 2 double bedrooms and a family bathroom.

The house is on Elgin Crescent which runs off Ladbroke Grove, within close proximity to the world famous Portobello Road.
